contradictions.a: so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
contradictions.b: so idh'eva sabrahmacāriṃ ākoseyya, anāpucchā pakkameyya.
contradictions.why: A describes offending a colleague and leaving without apologizing; B describes insulting a colleague and leaving without asking permission.
